'''September 2000 Stickney tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Crazy Cards and Comics, Stickney, Illinois on 23 September 2000. [[Edmund Gray]] won it. It is known from Edmund Gray's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1265">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-stikney-il-9-23-00d1265/ stikney-il-9-23-00], DeckTech (edmund "edmund" gray, 24 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-24-stikney-il-9-23-00d1265/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 September 2000
* '''Site:''' Crazy Cards and Comics, Stickney, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Edmund Gray]]
